```{r load-data}
# Resolve paths whether knitting from Transcriptomics/ or parent files/
if (file.exists("Stage2_transcriptomics_xcell.csv")) {
  base_dir       <- "."
  proteomics_dir <- "../proteomics"
  spatial_dir    <- "../spatial"
} else if (file.exists("Transcriptomics/Stage2_transcriptomics_xcell.csv")) {
  base_dir       <- "Transcriptomics"
  proteomics_dir <- "proteomics"
  spatial_dir    <- "spatial"
} else {
  stop(
    "Cannot locate Stage2_transcriptomics_xcell.csv. ",
    "Knit from Transcriptomics/ or its parent directory."
  )
}

helpers_path <- file.path(base_dir, "analysis_helpers.R")
if (!file.exists(helpers_path)) {
  stop("Missing analysis_helpers.R in ", base_dir)
}
source(helpers_path)
dirs <- setup_analysis_dirs(base_dir, "stage2")
output_dir <- dirs$output_dir

original_files <- c(
  xCell2 scores      = file.path(base_dir, "Stage2_transcriptomics_xcell.csv"),
  clinical data      = file.path(base_dir, "stage2/clinical.csv"),
  patient mapping    = file.path(spatial_dir, "master_patient_mapping.csv"),
  survival with risk = file.path(proteomics_dir, "survival_df_with_risk.rds"),
  ge clinical        = file.path(base_dir, "stage2/ge_project_rcsi_cohort_clinical.csv")
)
missing <- names(original_files)[!file.exists(original_files)]
if (length(missing) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing required original file(s):\n",
    paste0("  - ", missing, ": ", original_files[missing], collapse = "\n"),
    "\n\nRegenerate survival_df_with_risk.rds by running ",
    "proteomics/RCSI_Taxonomy_Combined_prognosis_scores.Rmd."
  )
}

# Read only from working copies — originals are never modified
working_files <- ensure_working_copies(original_files, dirs$work_dir)
xcell_path    <- working_files[[1]]
clinical_path <- working_files[[2]]
mapping_path  <- working_files[[3]]
survival_path <- working_files[[4]]
ge_clin_path  <- working_files[[5]]

stage2_res <- read_csv(xcell_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
clinical   <- read_csv(clinical_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
master_patient_mapping <- read_csv(mapping_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
survival_df_with_risk  <- readRDS(survival_path)
ge_project_rcsi_cohort_clinical <- read_csv(ge_clin_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

survival_df  <- survival_df_with_risk
surivival_df <- survival_df_with_risk
stage2       <- stage2_res

cat("Loaded", nrow(stage2_res) - 1, "cell types x", ncol(stage2_res) - 1, "samples\n")
cat("Risk groups in survival data:", paste(names(table(survival_df$risk_grp)), collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

```{r build-id-map-scores-long}
# Sample (T-tube) to patient mapping for downstream joins
sample_ids <- colnames(stage2)[-1]
t_ids <- sample_ids
g_ids <- patient_id_g

id_map <- data.frame(
  t_id = t_ids,
  g_id = g_ids,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Long-format enrichment scores with risk annotation (mapped High/Low only)
scores_long <- stage2_res %>%
  rename(cell_type = 1) %>%
  pivot_longer(-cell_type, names_to = "sample", values_to = "enrichment") %>%
  left_join(
    id_map %>% rename(sample = t_id, patient_id = g_id),
    by = "sample"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    survival_df %>% select(patient_id, risk_grp, rsf_risk),
    by = "patient_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(risk_grp %in% c("Low", "High"))

cat("scores_long rows:", nrow(scores_long), "\n")
cat("Samples with risk group:\n")
print(table(scores_long$sample, scores_long$risk_grp))

# High vs Low differential enrichment (Wilcoxon per cell type)
differential_results <- scores_long %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_high = mean(enrichment[risk_grp == "High"], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_low  = mean(enrichment[risk_grp == "Low"], na.rm = TRUE),
    log2FC    = log2((mean_high + 1e-10) / (mean_low + 1e-10)),
    pval      = wilcox.test(enrichment ~ risk_grp)$p.value,
    .groups   = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(neg_log10_p = -log10(pval))

print(differential_results %>%
        filter(cell_type %in% c("B cell", "Exhausted CD8+ T cells")))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Assign significance category
df <- differential_results_clean
df$sig <- "NS"
df$sig[abs(df$log2FC) > 0.5] <- "Log2 FC"
df$sig[df$pval < 0.05001 & abs(df$log2FC) > 0.5] <- "p-value and log2 FC"
df$sig[df$pval < 0.05001 & abs(df$log2FC) <= 0.5] <- "p-value"

# Assign numbers only to coloured (non-NS) points
df$label_num <- NA
coloured <- df$sig != "NS"
df$label_num[coloured] <- seq_len(sum(coloured))

# Colour map
col_map <- c(
  "NS"                  = "grey60",
  "Log2 FC"             = "#00b050",
  "p-value"             = "#4472c4",
  "p-value and log2 FC" = "#ff0000"
)

p_test <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(pval), colour = sig)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05001), linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.5, 0.5), linetype = "dashed", colour = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label_num), colour = "black", size = 3, vjust = -0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = col_map, name = "Significance") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = volcano_axes$xlim) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = volcano_axes$ylim) +
  labs(
    title    = "Cell Type Enrichment: High vs Low Risk",
    subtitle = "Stage 2 Transcriptomics | xCell2 scores",
    x        = "Log2 Fold Change (High / Low)",
    y        = "-Log10(p-value)"
  ) +
  # Number legend on the right
  annotate("text",
    x = 2.05,
    y = seq(max(-log10(df$pval), na.rm = TRUE) + 0.3,
            max(-log10(df$pval), na.rm = TRUE) + 0.3 - (sum(coloured)-1)*0.15,
            length.out = sum(coloured)),
    label = paste0(df$label_num[coloured], ": ", df$cell_type[coloured]),
    hjust = 0, size = 2.5, colour = "black"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    plot.margin    = ggplot2::margin(20, 200, 20, 20),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

print(p_test)
```

```{r risk-immune-heatmap}
## Patient-level heatmap: B cell and Exhausted CD8+ T cells vs DFS risk
heatmap_features <- c("B cell", "Exhausted CD8+ T cells")

heatmap_data <- scores_long %>%
  filter(cell_type %in% heatmap_features) %>%
  group_by(patient_id, cell_type, risk_grp, rsf_risk) %>%
  summarise(enrichment = mean(enrichment, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

patient_meta <- heatmap_data %>%
  distinct(patient_id, risk_grp, rsf_risk) %>%
  arrange(rsf_risk)

hm_wide <- heatmap_data %>%
  select(patient_id, cell_type, enrichment) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = patient_id, values_from = enrichment) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("cell_type") %>%
  as.matrix()

hm_wide <- hm_wide[, patient_meta$patient_id, drop = FALSE]

hm_log <- log10(hm_wide + 1e-6)
hm_z   <- t(scale(t(hm_log)))

ann_col <- data.frame(
  risk_grp = factor(patient_meta$risk_grp, levels = c("Low", "High")),
  row.names = patient_meta$patient_id
)

ann_colors <- list(
  risk_grp = c(Low = "#004B23", High = "#800000")
)

heatmap_stats <- lapply(heatmap_features, function(ct) {
  df <- heatmap_data %>% filter(cell_type == ct)
  sp <- cor.test(df$rsf_risk, df$enrichment, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  wx <- wilcox.test(enrichment ~ risk_grp, data = df)
  data.frame(
    cell_type  = ct,
    spearman_r = unname(sp$estimate),
    spearman_p = sp$p.value,
    wilcox_p   = wx$p.value,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
})
heatmap_stats <- bind_rows(heatmap_stats)

stats_label <- paste(
  apply(heatmap_stats, 1, function(r) {
    sprintf(
      "%s: Spearman r=%.3f (p=%.3g); Wilcoxon p=%.3g",
      r["cell_type"],
      as.numeric(r["spearman_r"]),
      as.numeric(r["spearman_p"]),
      as.numeric(r["wilcox_p"])
    )
  }),
  collapse = "\n"
)

print(heatmap_stats)

heatmap_title <- paste0(
  "Stage 2 xCell2 enrichment by DFS risk (n=",
  nrow(patient_meta), " patients)\n",
  stats_label
)

heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166AC", "white", "#B2182B"))(100)

n_low <- sum(patient_meta$risk_grp == "Low")
gaps_col <- if (n_low > 0L && n_low < ncol(hm_z)) n_low else NULL

draw_heatmap <- function() {
  pheatmap(
    hm_z,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    annotation_col = ann_col,
    annotation_colors = ann_colors,
    color = heatmap_colors,
    main = heatmap_title,
    fontsize_col = 7,
    fontsize_row = 11,
    border_color = NA,
    gaps_col = gaps_col
  )
}

out_pdf <- file.path(output_dir, "Stage2_risk_immune_heatmap.pdf")
out_png <- file.path(output_dir, "Stage2_risk_immune_heatmap.png")

pdf(out_pdf, width = 12, height = 4.5)
draw_heatmap()
dev.off()

png(out_png, width = 12, height = 4.5, units = "in", res = 300)
draw_heatmap()
dev.off()

cat("Saved:", out_pdf, "\n")
cat("Saved:", out_png, "\n")
```

```{r}
colnames(cor_df)[4] <- "MC_0"

spearman_corr <- cor.test(cor_df$enrichment, cor_df$MC_0, method = "spearman")

# Plot
ggplot(cor_df, aes(x = MC_0, y = enrichment)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "blue") +

           x = min(cor_df$MC_0, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = max(cor_df$enrichment, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = paste0("Pearson r = ", signif(pearson_corr$estimate, 3),
                          "\np = ", signif(pearson_corr$p.value, 3)),
           hjust = 0, colour = "darkred", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text",
           x = min(cor_df$MC_0, na.rm = TRUE),
           y = max(cor_df$enrichment, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.85,
           label = paste0("Spearman r = ", signif(spearman_corr$estimate, 3),
                          "\np = ", signif(spearman_corr$p.value, 3)),
           hjust = 0, colour = "darkgreen", size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title = "CD8+ T Cell Enrichment vs MC_0 Abundance",
    x     = "Abundance Metacluster Leiden 1.0 MC_0",
    y     = "CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell Enrichment Score"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(cowplot)

# Fix top3 as proper character vector
top3 <- c(
  "naive thymus-derived CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell",
  "dendritic cell",
  "CD8-positive, alpha-beta T cell"
)

plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(top3)) {
  ct <- top3[i]
  
  ct_scores <- scores_long[scores_long$cell_type %in% ct, c("sample", "enrichment")]
  ct_scores <- merge(ct_scores, id_map, by.x = "sample", by.y = "t_id")
  ct_cor_df <- merge(ct_scores,
                     survival_df[, c("patient_id", "abundance_metacluster_leiden_1.0_MC_0")],
                     by.x = "g_id", by.y = "patient_id")
  colnames(ct_cor_df)[4] <- "MC_0"
  
  # Skip if not enough data
  ct_cor_df <- ct_cor_df[is.finite(ct_cor_df$enrichment) & is.finite(ct_cor_df$MC_0), ]
  if (nrow(ct_cor_df) < 3) {
    message("Skipping ", ct, ": not enough observations (", nrow(ct_cor_df), ")")
    next
  }
  
  pearson_corr  <- cor.test(ct_cor_df$enrichment, ct_cor_df$MC_0, method = "pearson")
  spearman_corr <- cor.test(ct_cor_df$enrichment, ct_cor_df$MC_0, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  
  p <- ggplot(ct_cor_df, aes(x = MC_0, y = enrichment)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "blue") +
    annotate("text",
             x = min(ct_cor_df$MC_0, na.rm = TRUE),
             y = max(ct_cor_df$enrichment, na.rm = TRUE),
             label = paste0("Pearson r = ", signif(pearson_corr$estimate, 3),
                            "\np = ", signif(pearson_corr$p.value, 3)),
             hjust = 0, colour = "darkred", size = 3) +
    annotate("text",
             x = min(ct_cor_df$MC_0, na.rm = TRUE),
             y = max(ct_cor_df$enrichment, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.85,
             label = paste0("Spearman r = ", signif(spearman_corr$estimate, 3),
                            "\np = ", signif(spearman_corr$p.value, 3)),
             hjust = 0, colour = "darkgreen", size = 3) +
    labs(title = ct, x = "MC_0 Abundance", y = "Enrichment Score") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8))
  
  plot_list[[i]] <- p
}

# Remove NULL entries from skipped cell types
plot_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), plot_list)

plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = length(plot_list))
```

```{r}


## 1) Define the cell types of interest
cell_types <- c(
  "B cell",
  "conventional dendritic cell",
  "Exhausted CD8+ T cells"
)

plot_list <- list()

for (i in seq_along(cell_types)) {
  ct <- cell_types[i]
  
  # 2) Filter scores_long to this cell type
  ct_scores <- scores_long[
    scores_long$cell_type == ct,
    c("sample", "enrichment")
  ]
  
  # Map sample (tube) IDs to patient IDs via id_map
  ct_scores <- merge(
    ct_scores,
    id_map,
    by.x = "sample",
    by.y = "t_id"
  )
  
  # 3) Bring in continuous risk score from survival_df
  #    Replace 'rsf_risk' with the exact column name of your risk score
  ct_cor_df <- merge(
    ct_scores,
    survival_df[, c("patient_id", "rsf_risk")],
    by.x = "g_id",
    by.y = "patient_id"
  )
  
  colnames(ct_cor_df)[which(names(ct_cor_df) == "rsf_risk")] <- "risk_score"
  
  # Keep only finite values
  ct_cor_df <- ct_cor_df[
    is.finite(ct_cor_df$enrichment) & is.finite(ct_cor_df$risk_score),
  ]
  
  # Skip if too few points
  if (nrow(ct_cor_df) < 3) {
    message("Skipping ", ct, ": not enough observations (", nrow(ct_cor_df), ")")
    next
  }
  
  # 4) Pearson and Spearman correlations (enrichment vs risk_score)
  pearson_corr  <- cor.test(ct_cor_df$enrichment, ct_cor_df$risk_score, method = "pearson")
  spearman_corr <- cor.test(ct_cor_df$enrichment, ct_cor_df$risk_score, method = "spearman")
  
  # 5) Plot: risk_score vs enrichment for this cell type
  p <- ggplot(ct_cor_df, aes(x = risk_score, y = enrichment)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, colour = "blue") +
    labs(
      title = ct,
      x = "Risk score",
      y = "Enrichment score"
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = min(ct_cor_df$risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      y = max(ct_cor_df$enrichment, na.rm = TRUE),
      label = paste0(
        "Pearson r = ", signif(pearson_corr$estimate, 3),
        "\nP = ", signif(pearson_corr$p.value, 3)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      colour = "darkred",
      size = 3
    ) +
    annotate(
      "text",
      x = min(ct_cor_df$risk_score, na.rm = TRUE),
      y = max(ct_cor_df$enrichment, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.9,
      label = paste0(
        "Spearman r = ", signif(spearman_corr$estimate, 3),
        "\nP = ", signif(spearman_corr$p.value, 3)
      ),
      hjust = 0,
      colour = "darkgreen",
      size = 3
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 9))
  
  plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- p
}

## 6) Arrange the plots side by side
if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = length(plot_list))
} else {
  message("No plots generated: all cell types had insufficient data.")
}
```

```{r}
# Check that risk_grp exists and looks right
table(survival_df$risk_grp)

cell_types <- c(
  "B cell",
  "conventional dendritic cell",
  "Exhausted CD8+ T cells"
)

plot_list <- list()

for (ct in cell_types) {
  # 1) Get enrichment for this cell type from scores_long
  ct_scores <- scores_long %>%
    filter(cell_type == ct) %>%
    transmute(sample, enrichment)   # explicitly name columns
  
  # 2) Map sample IDs to patient IDs via id_map
  ct_scores <- ct_scores %>%
    inner_join(id_map, by = c("sample" = "t_id"))  # adds g_id
  
  # 3) Join risk group from survival_df
  ct_df <- ct_scores %>%
    inner_join(
      survival_df %>% 
        transmute(patient_id, risk_grp),  # explicitly: just these two columns
      by = c("g_id" = "patient_id")
    )
  
  if (nrow(ct_df) < 3) {
    message("Skipping ", ct, ": not enough observations (", nrow(ct_df), ")")
    next
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(ct_df, aes(x = risk_grp, y = enrichment, fill = risk_grp)) +
    geom_violin(alpha = 0.6, trim = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.3, fill = "white", outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = ct,
      x = "Risk group",
      y = "xCell2 enrichment score"
    ) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 9)
    )
  
  plot_list[[length(plot_list) + 1]] <- p
}

if (length(plot_list) > 0) {
  plot_grid(plotlist = plot_list, ncol = length(plot_list))
} else {
  message("No plots generated: all cell types had insufficient data.")
}
```
